scope: Remove fuzzy paired-edge witness parameter admission for shared mortar pages. Interior witness pairs require exact Q25 collinearity and equal exact segment parameter; exact corresponding endpoints are allowed. Paired-edge suppression additionally requires exact physical coincidence of both mapped endpoints at the accepted start. The existing 8e-6 value is retained only as a minimum barycentric edge-length degeneracy guard.
